comments.body: [arch] ACKNOWLEDGED — The base path duplication between nav.html and footer.html is pre-existing. Extracting to a shared helper is a good future improvement but out of scope for this change.
[arch] VERIFIED — Confirmed the `<%= base %>/pages/` pattern matches nav.html which uses `<%= base %>/pages/about.html`. Consistent with established convention.
[css] VERIFIED — The footer-links styles are placed immediately after .copyright, which is the correct location within the FOOTER section of the CSS.
[css] FIXED — Bumped footer link font-size from 11px to 12px to match .copyright text size for visual consistency.
[responsive] VERIFIED — 600px breakpoint matches the existing nav breakpoint already in the CSS. Footer-links uses flex which stacks properly within the column layout.
